title: Dutch Stew with Gruyère
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tender beef, root vegetables, and a rich Gruyère sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Dutch stew, tomato paste, and flour. Stir to combine.
Add the potatoes and enough broth to cover the meat and vegetables.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the grated Gruyère cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with black pepper to taste.
